claims.evidence: No weight marking or scale reading is visible in any photo; the witness report lists cylinder weight as not shown.
Photo 1 and Photo 2 show a gas cylinder with a metal valve and collar consistent with a cooking gas cylinder; the witness identifies the kind as gas cylinder.

risks.risk: Cylinder may be empty or contain an unknown amount of gas.
risks.proof: Video of the cylinder on a weighing scale showing the total weight.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an empty cylinder (cylinder only, no gas).

risks.risk: Expiry or last test date may be missing or expired.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the date stamped on the collar or body.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as expired or uncertified (requires revalidation before safe use).

risks.risk: Valve and seals may be damaged, worn, or leaking.
risks.proof: Close-up video of the valve being operated and a leak-test clip at the outlet.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a faulty valve (needs repair or replacement).

risks.risk: The listing may cover only one of the two cylinders shown (yellow and blue).
risks.proof: Photo showing both cylinders together with a dated note confirming they are sold as one lot.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a single cylinder only.

proof_requests: Weighing scale reading showing cylinder weight
Close-up photo of expiry or last test date stamp
Close-up video of valve operation and seal condition
Photo showing both cylinders together to confirm they are one listing
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a gas cylinder, so it can be priced at its worst case; the seller's 12.5kg claim cannot be verified remotely and key condition details are missing.
